featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Flavours of China at Prabhadevi recently and had a pleasant experience overall. First things first – parking is quite a challenge in this area, so it’s better to plan ahead or park in lanes nearby.

The restaurant is small and simple, not a fancy place, but clean and decently maintained. What truly makes it stand out is the hospitality of the staff. From helping us with menu recommendations to being attentive throughout the meal, the service was impressive. They made sure no plate was left empty and were quick to respond whenever we needed something.

Coming to the food – everything was freshly prepared, served piping hot, and packed with flavor. The portion sizes were generous, making it great value for money.

If you’re looking for a no-frills Chinese dining experience with great service and delicious food, Flavours of China is worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: rajesh jaiswar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flavours Of China in Prabhadevi is a solid go-to spot for Indo-Chinese and Thai cuisine, especially if you’re looking for tasty food at reasonable pricing in the South Mumbai area.

🍽️ Food:
The food is definitely the highlight here. Their menu offers a wide variety—from classic Chinese gravies and noodles to Thai curries and rice. Dishes like burnt garlic rice, Manchurian, and Thai curries stand out for their bold flavours and generous portions. The taste is consistent, slightly on the Indianised side (which most people prefer), and perfect for comfort dining. Many customers also appreciate the freshness and customizable options available.

🥢 Portion Size & Value:
Portions are quite generous, making it ideal for sharing. Pricing is pocket-friendly for the quality and quantity offered, making it a great value-for-money option in the area.

🏠 Ambience:
The ambience is simple and casual—not a fine dining place, but clean and comfortable for a quick meal with friends or family. Seating space is slightly limited, so it can feel a bit cramped during peak hours.

🧑‍🍳 Service:
Service is generally quick, especially for takeaway and delivery orders. However, during busy hours, there can be slight delays and service could be more attentive.

📍 Location:
Conveniently located in Prabhadevi near Century Bazaar, it’s easily accessible and a popular neighbourhood dining spot.

⸻

✅ Pros:

* Delicious Indo-Chinese flavours
* Generous portion sizes
* Good value for money
* Wide menu variety (Chinese + Thai)

featured_reviews.name: Dr Prasad Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited KOKO, Lower Parel, on a completely last-minute plan. Their lunch service goes on till 4:00 pm, with the last order taken at 3:15 pm. Luckily, we managed to reach just in time at 3:10 pm.

We ordered the KOKO Signature Roll (avocado, tempura asparagus, crisps, and KOKO sauce) along with Hong Kong Soy Noodles with chicken.

The sushi was the absolute highlight for me – crisp, fresh, and packed with layers of flavour. Every bite was a delight, and it’s definitely something I would love to come back for. The noodles, on the other hand, had a very balanced and subtle taste, making it a nice complement to the meal.

Overall, it was a great experience. The service was quick even though we ordered at the last moment, and the food quality was impressive. Good going, KOKO – I sincerely hope they continue maintaining these high standards!

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Where do i begin! Best meal i had in mumbai was at KOKO. The mushroom turnip cake, baby potatoes, signature sushi, the noodles , thai lemonade absolutely fire - 10/10. Service 11/10 and ambiance was great too! So worth it, definitely recommend this place if you’re in mumbai, hope they open in delhi soon :)

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Minal Kabra
featured_reviews.review_text:
KOKO, Lower Parel – A Luxe Asian Dining Experience

KOKO in Lower Parel offers a refined and memorable dining experience. The ambiance is top-notch — modern, elegant, and perfect for an evening out. The menu features an impressive variety of sushi and dim sum, with ample vegetarian choices that are just as flavorful and thoughtfully prepared as the non-vegetarian options.

The staff is courteous and attentive, adding to the overall premium feel of the place. However, a heads-up for first-timers — they don’t usually offer tables without a reservation, even if some appear to be vacant. Be prepared to sit at the bar if you walk in without prior booking.

That said, once you’re seated, the food and experience are absolutely worth it. For anyone who appreciates quality Asian cuisine in a sophisticated setting, KOKO is highly recommended — just make sure to reserve in advance!

featured_reviews.name: WK
featured_reviews.review_text:
THE PLACE TO BE!
Great location, super friendly staff and a great choice of high quality food for all diet restrictions. They even have special gluten free dishes. The first restaurant which even offers gluten-free soy sauce. Fantastic so even I could enjoy the wonderful flavour of soy sauce and miso soup.
You can ask the team for some extras like you want dishes without onions or garlic...
All the dishes were flavoured perfectly and with love.

The dessert was a creamy fluffy dream. And the espresso too.
Absolutely all on point.

Price wise it's not cheap. We paid 60 EUR ala cards. They have special brunches like the father's day brunch for 25 EUR plus taxes. These  prices are absolutely fair but eating ala cards is expensive as the portions are not that big.

Nevertheless a fantastic restaurant and we definitely will visit again as the food is incredibly good.

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Flavours of China in Dadar West for a friend’s birthday celebration, and it turned out to be a delightful dining experience. Though the place is modest in size, the ambience has a distinct charm with classic Chinese-style décor and wall hangings that add to the vibe.

We started off with Chicken Lollipop with Gravy and Chicken Crispy – both starters were well-prepared, flavorful, and had the perfect balance of spice and texture.

For the main course, we opted for Malaysian Fried Rice, Red Thai Curry with Jasmine Rice, and Asian Pot Rice. The Malaysian Fried Rice had green-color, offering a unique twist, while the Red Thai Curry was undoubtedly the highlight – rich, aromatic, and beautifully presented.

Special mention to Mr. Shrikant for his prompt and attentive service, which added to the overall positive experience.

If you're looking for a cozy Chinese dining spot in Dadar with good food and courteous service, Flavours of China is worth a visit.
